name: UNSWEEP
description: Incident-response tool for rescuing ERC-20 tokens from wallets compromised by sweeper bots on Base and Arbitrum using EIP-7702 atomic sponsored transactions. Read-only diagnostics, local signing without seed phrase collection, and verifiable on-chain contracts.

open_source_repos.name: UNSWEEP
open_source_repos.description: EIP-7702 atomic token rescue contracts and diagnostics for sweeper-compromised wallets on Base and Arbitrum.
